intro.text: An Alethi sailor learning his trade on Thaylen ships at Queen Jasnah Kholin's order.

items.text: Dok joined Captain Smta's crew late in 1174. Yalb took him under his wing and pulled the usual prank on new sailors, tricking him into claiming he saw a made-up "sailorspren" to win a small bet. Before Yalb could win Dok's spheres with a bigger bet, he spotted the ship First Dreams on the horizon.
